SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc, 1, 20) AS r_reason_desc,
    AVG(ws_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(wr_refunded_cash) AS avg_refunded_cash,
    AVG(wr_fee) AS avg_fee
FROM
    (SELECT 
         ws_item_sk, 
         ws_order_number, 
         ws_quantity, 
         ws_sales_price, 
         ws_net_profit, 
         ws_web_page_sk
     FROM web_sales
     WHERE 
         ws_sold_date_sk IN (
             SELECT d_date_sk 
             FROM date_dim 
             WHERE d_year = 1998
         )
         AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 200.00
         AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
    ) AS filtered_ws
JOIN web_returns ON 
    filtered_ws.ws_item_sk = web_returns.wr_item_sk 
    AND filtered_ws.ws_order_number = web_returns.wr_order_number
JOIN web_page ON 
    filtered_ws.ws_web_page_sk = web_page.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN customer_address ON 
    customer_address.ca_address_sk = web_returns.wr_refunded_addr_sk
JOIN reason ON 
    reason.r_reason_sk = web_returns.wr_reason_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd1 ON 
    cd1.cd_demo_sk = web_returns.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2 ON 
    cd2.cd_demo_sk = web_returns.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
WHERE 
    customer_address.ca_country = 'United States'
    AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
    AND (
        (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND filtered_ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
        OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND filtered_ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
        OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND filtered_ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
    )
    AND (
        (customer_address.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND filtered_ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
        OR (customer_address.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND filtered_ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
        OR (customer_address.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND filtered_ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
    )
GROUP BY 
    r_reason_desc
ORDER BY 
    r_reason_desc, 
    avg_quantity, 
    avg_refunded_cash, 
    avg_fee
LIMIT 100
